name: Rampaging Aetherhood
oracle_text:
Trample, ward {2}
At the beginning of your upkeep, you get an amount of {E} (energy counters) equal to this creature's power. Then you may pay one or more {E}. If you do, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your upkeep, you get an amount of {E} (energy counters) equal to this creature's power. Then you may pay one or more {E}. If you do, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.

needs.what: a `may` that lets the player announce how many {E} to pay, from 1 up to their current energy, charges exactly that much energy, and binds the count (e.g. `any_amount: {"as": "paid"}` accepted beside `pay: {"pay_energy": 1}`) so a following `add_counters` can read `{"binding": "paid"}` as the number of +1/+1 counters
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `may.any_amount` is the right shape but loader/effects._validate_pay_any_amount refuses any `pay` other than exactly one coloured or {C} mana symbol, and op_may scales only the mana half of the cost; Cost.pay_energy is a fixed int (carddef.py), so no value expression or chosen amount can price it; `choose_number` cannot bound its max by the player's energy because no value key reads a player's energy count. Trample, ward {2}, the upkeep trigger and add_energy with power_of self are otherwise expressible
